```{r}
library(stargazer)
```


```{r}

plot_data <- wind_solar_data_tot %>% 
  filter( as.Date(date) >= "2020-05-01" & as.Date(date) <= "2020-05-05" )

ggplot(plot_data, aes( x= date))+
  geom_line(aes(y= global_tilted_irradiance*10, color = "Sun Irradiance")) +
  geom_line(aes(y= wind_speed_100m*100, color = "Wind Speed")) +
  geom_line(aes(y= Fore_Wind, color = "Wind P°")) +
  geom_line(aes(y= Fore_Solar, color = "Solar P°"))+
  labs(
    title = "Wind and Solar Data",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Value",
    color = "Legend"
  )
  
```



```{r}

reg_table <- stargazer(model_solar, model_solarc, model_solarfe,
    type = "text",
    title = "Regression Results",
    column.labels = c("Basic",  "+ Controls","Time FE"),
    keep = c(
    "precipitation_demand", "temperature_demand", "relative_humidity_demand",
    "wind_speed_100m", "global_tilted_irradiance"
    )
)
```

```{r}
save_var_path <- 'C:/Users/DBT3KD/Desktop/Etude_macro_elec/prix_electricite_gitlab/Data_structuring/output'
setwd(save_var_path)
IV_data_esp <- read_parquet('IV_data_esp.parquet') 

setwd(save_var_path)
IV_data_fr <- read_parquet('IV_data_fr.parquet') 

library(ggplot2)

ggplot() +
  # Temperature-related instruments (on secondary axis)
  geom_line(data = IV_data_fr, aes(x = datetime, y = cold_excess_instrument, color = "Cold Excess")) +
  geom_line(data = IV_data_fr, aes(x = datetime, y = heat_excess_instrument, color = "Heat Excess")) +
  # Generation lines (scaled down)
  geom_line(data = IV_data_esp, aes(x = datetime, y = gen_tot / 10000, color = "ES Generation")) +
  geom_line(data = IV_data_fr, aes(x = datetime, y = gen_tot / 10000, color = "FR Generation")) +

  # Primary axis for generation
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Temperature Excess Index",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ .*10, name = "Generation (GW)")  # second axis, same scale
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Generation and Temperature Patterns",
    x = "Date",
    color = "Variable"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )



```
